<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:flowduet="urn:flowduet:bpmn" xmlns:flowable="http://flowable.org/bpmn" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="flow_1_defs" targetNamespace="http://flowduet.dev/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="flow_1" name="未命名流程" isExecutable="true" flowduet:defaultFormKey="missing_default">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="开始">
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_start</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="approval_1" name="审批节点" flowable:assignee="${boss}" flowable:formKey="form_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_start</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_end</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_end</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_start" sourceRef="start" targetRef="approval_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_end" sourceRef="approval_1" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="flow_1_di">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="flow_1_plane" bpmnElement="flow_1">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="start_di" bpmnElement="start">
        <dc:Bounds x="72" y="40" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="approval_1_di" bpmnElement="approval_1">
        <dc:Bounds x="40" y="136" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="end_di" bpmnElement="end">
        <dc:Bounds x="72" y="276" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="flow_start_di" bpmnElement="flow_start">
        <di:waypoint x="90" y="76" />
        <di:waypoint x="90" y="136" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="flow_end_di" bpmnElement="flow_end">
        <di:waypoint x="90" y="216" />
        <di:waypoint x="90" y="276" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
